$source.note: After the language of a contemporary-art exhibition identity built from generated 'dreams'. The PDF is set in the dreamscape layout (render/layouts/dreamscape.ts): a full-bleed cover drawn by a generator seeded with the title — notched discs that step round into a spiral, or discs sinking into a tunnel — in a sunrise ramp from indigo through magenta to orange; the title in a screen-pixel face (Pixelify Sans); the document's own words set as snake_case data keys and [ bracketed ] tags in JetBrains Mono; section openings on their own seeded dream bands; black interface panels with thin outlined boxes for statements, gates and the close; gates drawn as rings round one centre. Body in Manrope. No artwork, mark or name of any museum or agency is used. Word gets the ordinary page in these colours and faces.
